stories.title: Molly Meldrum
stories.summary: Australian music journalist and media personality (1943–2026)
stories.about: Ian Alexander "Molly" Meldrum was an Australian television presenter, music critic, journalist, record producer and musical businessman. He was the talent coordinator, on-air interviewer and news presenter of the music television program Countdown (1974–1987). He became widely recognised for his Stetson hats, which he had regularly worn in public from the 1980s.
